Prince Thaddeus slew 100 dragons.  
Prince Arthur slew three quarters as many as Prince Thaddeus: $ 100 \times \frac{3}{4} = 75 $.  
Prince Walter slew twice as many as Prince Arthur: $ 75 \times 2 = 150 $.  
Prince Bruce slew one-fifth as many as Prince Walter: $ 150 \times \frac{1}{5} = 30 $.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 30
